crossRefs.note: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
“When the sky is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place…
Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before…
This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax…
How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are…

translations.web: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
translations.bsb: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.
translations.kjv: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
translations.asv: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholdeth its fruit.
